4 [F12Initial duty to disclose]: further provisions.

(1) This section applies where—
(a) the prosecutor acts under section 3, and
(b) before so doing he was given a document in pursuance of provision included,
by virtue of section 24(3), in a code operative under Part II.

(2) In such a case the prosecutor must give the document to the accused at the same time
as the prosecutor acts under section 3.
